items.title: Lore – Local AI thought capture and recall that runs on your machine
items.raw_excerpt: I built Lore because I kept losing knowledge — curl commands, quick notes from standups, and that one thing I told myself I'd remember. It lives in the system tray, a global shortcut pops it up, you type naturally, and it stores or retrieves automatically. Everything runs locally via Ollama + LanceDB — no cloud, no API keys. It classifies your input (thought, question, todo, instruction) and uses a RAG pipeline to answer recall queries from your own stored context. It's free and open source under MIT license, and even though its in very early version me and my friends have been using it for a while and we can't live without it. Would love to hear what you think about it https://github.com/ErezShahaf/Lore Stars would appreciated :)

2026 marks the beginning of the 15th Five-Year Plan and a critical milestone for China as it advances toward the basic realization of socialist modernization by 2035. At this historical juncture, technological innovation serves not only as an engine for economic development but also as a cornerstone for national rejuvenation. On March 14, International Mathematics Day, Runzeyuan Education held an "Infinite Innovation" conference at the Hangzhou International Expo Center in Zhejiang. Using the infinite, non-repeating nature of pi (π) as a metaphor, the event explored how Chinese entrepreneurs can forge an innovative path that balances technological advancement with humanistic warmth amid the rapid development of AI.  

The conference attracted nearly 200 entrepreneurs, researchers, and senior executives from the technology sector. Speakers included Tao Fangbo, former head of Alibaba DAMO Academy’s Neuro-Symbolic Lab and founder of Mindverse Universe; Zhou Hengxing, interviewer of Elon Musk, biographer of OpenAI founder Sam Altman, and founder of overseas tech media Pandaily; Liao Jieyuan, founder and chairman of WeDoctor Group; Zhang Shengnan, founding team member of BrainCo and group vice president; and Bai Lixin, founder of Runzeyuan Education and a Ph.D. in engineering from Zhejiang University, among other notable figures.  

It is reported that Runzeyuan Education, established in 2012, is dedicated to promoting the creative transformation and innovative development of Chinese classics. Particularly in the field of Yangming Mind Studies, Runzeyuan Education has achieved the highest unprompted recall rate. With leadership at its core, its courses have attracted over 1 million participants, primarily targeting business operators and managers.

items.title: Prose2Policy (P2P): A Practical LLM Pipeline for Translating Natural-Language Access Policies into Executable Rego
items.raw_excerpt: Prose2Policy (P2P) is a LLM-based practical tool that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code (the policy language of Open Policy Agent, OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline that performs policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, automatic test generation and execution. Prose2Policy is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC) while emphasizing deployment reliability and auditability.
